<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a C‑Cl (halide) bond is broken and a C‑N bond is formed. The forward reaction therefore breaks a halide functional group and forms an amine (C‑N) bond. We'll search the template catalog for entries with a broken “halide” group and a formed “amine” group, also specifying the bond changes (C‑Cl broken, C‑N formed) to narrow to SN2‑type templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
